All work is complete and verified. Final summary of the implementation:

## Changes in `src/`

**New â shared bit arithmetic (`addrbits.hpp`)**: MSB-first 128-bit helpers (zero-padded final chunks, fragment extraction, NI bitmap position/level, per-forest cursor chunking).

**New â exact live FIB model (`fib.hpp`/`fib.cpp`)**: distinct normalized (length, left-aligned value) prefixes with **last-write-wins** hops in an open-addressing index that answers exact and longest-prefix queries.

**Completed â packed image pipeline (`image.cpp`, `image.hpp`, `utils/mem_init.{h,cpp}`)**:
- *Export* (`MemInit::capture` â `build_image`): canonical per-forest trie (TYPE4/5 leaves carry 1â2 prefixes inline at any relative length; larger subtrees branch, keeping prefixes ending within six bits as NI entries), TYPE1/2/3 by child count, stages `10-t` (strictly decreasing), dense compact placement with contiguous even two-cell bulk groups in key order, NI pattern dictionary (distinct, ascending) plus the single NI vector, and **global BMPs** (longest FIB prefix â¤ node depth matching the whole node region, crossing forest ownership).
- *Load*: full validation â shape/bounds, whole-graph walk from root + both front lists (aliasing, holes, overlaps, stage ordering, types vs. owned arities, reserved bits, NI positions/coverage/dictionary usage, foreign or host-bit-dirty inline prefixes, duplicate prefixes, bulk/direct clashes, dense coverage, padding zeros), then rebuilds the image's FIB and re-verifies **every** BMP before atomically committing.
- *Lookup*: only from the loaded image â 64-bit front â 16-bit front â depth-0 root; inline prefixes, NI bitmaps, BMP fallback.

**Entry point (`main.cpp`)**: live core + exact FIB model + loaded image per case; `save` via the exporter, `load`/`load_saved` via the validating loader. `msg_error` now reports on stderr and throws, and the live insert is contained so a subsystem failure can never truncate a response.

## Verification
